dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: These are the bounties. If you want to negotiate prices, go find a flea market.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the bounty target...

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: This is "Crackjaw" Hark. Several months ago, he was spotted near the Nothing Passage, but there haven't been any sightings since. He might've gone into hiding, we think.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Honestly... We don't have much hope of bringing him to justice unless we have more information.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: All the previous targets have been handled. There aren't any new bounties right now, so you'll just have to wait a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: That said, it wouldn't be such a bad thing if there were never any new bounties again. Bounties exist to keep criminals in check, and if that's already working, all the better.
